title: New Tab Chess
tagline: Transform every open tab into a quick bullet chess match.
description: A lightweight browser extension replacing the default new tab page with an immediate bullet chess board and rating tracker.
longDescription: Built to seamlessly integrate bullet chess practice into daily workflow. Features instant board initialization, tactical puzzle modes, and performance analytics.
keyFeatures: Instant bullet chess game board loading on new browser tab creation
Local and API-synced rating baseline tracking
Minimalist dark UI optimized for rapid board vision

title: Nunchi Health
tagline: Headless CMS migration and performant web architecture for youth mental health.
description: Production custom website migration replacing Squarespace with a high-performance headless architecture.
longDescription: Complete architectural overhaul porting legacy Squarespace content into an Astro.js frontend coupled with Payload CMS, deployed on Cloudflare Pages and Workers with integrated Stripe donation flows.
keyFeatures: Headless Astro.js SSG setup delivering sub-second page loads
Payload CMS backend for localized mental health content authoring
Edge routing and serverless processing via Cloudflare Workers
Custom Stripe checkout pipeline for direct non-profit funding

title: KOTOR II Inspired Portfolio
tagline: Interactive developer portfolio modeled after sci-fi tactical UI aesthetics.
description: Minimalist, multi-themed software engineering portfolio styled after the Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II interface.
longDescription: A technical showcase featuring interactive UI animations, typed Astro content collections, dynamic dark/sci-fi theme switching, and custom GSAP scroll sequences.
keyFeatures: HUD visual design inspired by KOTOR II interface panels
GSAP motion triggers and reactive component transitions
Astro Content Collections for strictly typed project/blog schemas
Multi-theme switcher with persistent local storage state

title: Shinki Showdown
tagline: Fast-paced 2D platform survival game built with custom pixel art.
description: 2D arcade platform survival game inspired by Brawlhalla combat and Noragami lore.
longDescription: Action platformer focusing on wave survival, frame-accurate hitboxes, and responsive movement mechanics written directly in Canvas and TypeScript.
keyFeatures: Custom 2D physics engine for collision resolution and jump gravity
Original sprite frame animations and combat particle effects
Dynamic difficulty scaling with persistent high score tracking

title: CUNY Student Hub & Club Builder
tagline: Role-based administrative and collaboration portal for campus organizations.
description: Full-stack web application designed to streamline student organization governance, budgeting, and event management.
longDescription: Engineered to eliminate administrative hurdles in college student organizations. Features real-time board collaboration, role-based access control, and automated event request pipelines.
keyFeatures: Real-time multi-user document/board editing via Liveblocks
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for club executives, treasurers, and members
Relational PostgreSQL schema tracking organizational budgets and meeting logs

title: GitHub Issue Roulette
tagline: Gamified task selector for open-source contributors and dev teams.
description: Developer utility fetching open repository issues and randomly selecting actionable items via an interactive wheel UI.
longDescription: Designed to resolve task selection fatigue. Integrates with GitHub's REST/GraphQL API to query open issue queues, filter by labels (e.g., `good-first-issue`), and assign tasks at random.
keyFeatures: OAuth2 authentication for GitHub private/public repository access
Dynamic issue filtering by milestone, assignee, and difficulty tag
Physics-based visual wheel animation rendering in Canvas

title: Spotify Synchronized Lyrics Engine
tagline: Real-time lyric synchronization companion app for Spotify playback.
description: Web app tracking active playback state to display synchronized, auto-scrolling lyrics.
longDescription: Interfaces with Spotify's Web API to sync current playback millisecond timestamps with synced lyrics feeds, rendering smooth text transitions.
keyFeatures: Sub-100ms sync alignment with Spotify API active player state
Dynamic typography view with auto-scroll highlighting
Compact overlay layout mode

title: Government WATCH DOGS
tagline: Civic tech platform summarizing legislative bills and voting records.
description: Data-driven platform promoting civic transparency by summarizing legislative bills and track representative voting histories.
longDescription: Collects official government legislative feeds and uses structured text analysis to convert complex bills into plain-language policy overviews.
keyFeatures: Automated bill intake pipeline producing succinct legislative summaries
Representative voting histories and policy area tracking
Searchable database of active local and federal legislation
